priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P2] Restore listener removal in the returned cleanup
findings.body: Calling the function returned by attach no longer unregisters the message handler. Disposed consumers will continue receiving messages, and repeated attach/cleanup cycles will accumulate duplicate listeners and retain handler references.

findings.title: [P2] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/socket.ts:3 still returns a no-op disposer, while line 2 registers handler with socket.on("message", handler); the full PR diff confirms this PR removed socket.off("message", handler), so cleanup does not detach the listener.
